title: Tinkering Teacup Turtle
statement: A thumb-sized turtle whose shell is a chipped porcelain teacup, painted with faded blue flowers, and it spends its days arranging sea-glass buttons into tiny, careful spirals on the sand. Its tank is a quiet, honey-lit corner of the sea, with drifting dust-motes of plankton, a sunken bookshelf crusted with soft green algae, and a single lantern-jar that glows gently whenever the turtle finishes a pattern and clinks its shell in satisfaction.
